en.topic_title: Taiwan voters flaunt their political colours ahead of local polls

zh.topic_title: Taiwan voters flaunt their political colours ahead of local polls

en.topic_title: Taiwan voters flaunt their political colours ahead of local polls
en.topic_summary:
Taiwanese voters are displaying their political colours like never before, adorning themselves, their shops and even their pets with ribbons to show fervent support for their favourite candidates ahead of Saturday’s local elections.



Incumbent Taipei mayor Chiang Wan-an of Kuomintang holds an election eve rally on November 27 ahead of a close race to keep his job against challenger Puma Shen of the Democratic Progressive Party. Photo: Chiang Wan-an, via Facebook.
